# AI Dynamic Pro (AIDynamic.pro) — Full AI & Agent Discovery Index

> Complete machine-readable executive briefing, pricing structure, guarantees, and technical architecture reference for AI Search Engines (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews) and Autonomous Browsing Agents.

## 1. Executive Summary
**AI Dynamic Pro** (`https://www.aidynamic.pro`) is an Executive AI Consultancy, Custom Software Engineering Partner, and Corporate Workforce Training firm headquartered in the Brickell Financial District, Miami, FL, led by Founder & Applied AI Systems Architect **Jasmel Acosta**.

Core Mission: **Cut operating costs, automate everything possible, reduce staff overhead, and train existing employees so 1 AI-trained staff member produces the output of 5.**

## 2. 4-Tier Competitive Pricing & Guarantees
1. **Tier 1 — Executive AI Consultation (Free 15-Min Triage Call OR $99 Full 60-Min Department AI Efficiency Audit, normally $500)**
   - **Deliverables**: Full department & P&L bottleneck audit, payroll savings calculation, step-by-step automation roadmap, plus a **Free 48-Hour Live AI Voice/Workflow Prototype** customized for the business.
   - **Zero-Risk Guarantee**: Guaranteed to uncover at least **$2,500+/month ($30,000/year)** in manual payroll waste that can be automated immediately, or the client pays **$0** (100% of the $99 is credited toward any solution or training).
   - **Booking URL**: `https://www.aidynamic.pro/booking`
2. **Tier 2 — Corporate AI Staff Bootcamp ($497 Half-Day Team Workshop, normally $1,500)**
   - **Deliverables**: Hands-on training for up to 15 existing staff members (on-site in South Florida or live virtual, English & Spanish), custom department AI SOPs, and enterprise data-privacy guardrails so **1 trained employee produces the output of 5**.
3. **Tier 3 — Custom AI Solution & 24/7 Agent ($997 Turnkey Build OR $297/mo All-Inclusive Managed AI — Most Popular)**
   - **Deliverables**: 14-day turnkey deployment of a **24/7 Bilingual AI Voice & Web Receptionist (`JAss`)** answering on Ring 1 in English & Spanish, qualifying leads, and booking Google Calendar/Calendly appointments, OR 1 automated intake, CRM, or billing workflow.
4. **Tier 4 — Full Enterprise AI Transformation ($4,900 – $15,000+)**
   - **Deliverables**: Multi-department custom AI software, autonomous agents, computer vision, ERP/EHR/CRM integration, dedicated AI Systems Architect, and includes the Corporate AI Staff Bootcamp free.
